---
title: "Math 119 — Applied Calculus for Data Analysis"
---

{{< include _today.qmd >}}

---

This course connects calculus concepts to real-world data analysis using R and Mathematica. You'll model LED bulb degradation, fit data using maximum likelihood, and analyze probability distributions — building mathematical intuition through hands-on computation.

---

## Getting Started (Week 1)

::: {.callout-tip}
## First Week Checklist

**Before Class 1:**
1. Read the [Syllabus](https://byui.instructure.com){target="_blank"} on Canvas
2. Complete the Background Survey (Canvas)
3. Open KnewtonAlta and try a few questions

**Before Class 2:**
1. Install [R](https://www.r-project.org/){target="_blank"} and [Positron](projects/positron_install.qmd) (our IDE)
2. Plot a simple function in R (see [Class 2](class/class-2.qmd) prep)
3. Review equation-solving strategies

**First Two Weeks:**
- Work through [Example Project](projects/project1_practice.qmd) to learn the workflow
- Start [Project 1](projects/unit1.qmd) (due Week 6)
:::

---

## Course Structure

### Class Sessions (46 total)
Daily class pages guide your learning with prep work, in-class activities, and practice problems. Use the **Class Sessions** sidebar to navigate by day.

**Need help finding a topic?** Use [**Help → Topic Index**](topics.qmd) to search by concept (e.g., "chain rule", "uniroot", "maximum likelihood").

### Three Major Projects
1. **[Project 1: LED Bulb Lifetime](projects/unit1.qmd)** (Weeks 1-6) — Function modeling, visual fitting, uniroot
2. **[Project 2: Maximum Likelihood](projects/unit2.qmd)** (Weeks 7-10) — Derivatives, optimization, calculus-based fitting
3. **[Project 3: Probability Distributions](projects/unit3.qmd)** (Weeks 11-13) — Integration, expected value, variance

Projects use **specifications grading**: your work earns "Complete" when it meets all five specs. Revise and resubmit until it does.

### Weekly Practice
**KnewtonAlta homework** reinforces skills. Complete assignments by their due dates to stay on track.
